title: Chunguru Matek Kuom Ruoth
stanzas: En e tekowa, bende ngimawa Ka richo dwaro lowa.
Chungi kuom adier kiwuotho e piny, Bed gi chuny maler kod yie motegno;
Kwageno Ruodhwa, wanalo chutho Richo duto manie piny.
Kristo Ruoth kende mamiyi yueyo Ka chandruok mar piny rumo.
chorus: Ka wadhil e lwenjwa,wanabed gi mor,
